name: com.photo2ads/ad-studio
title: Photo2Ads
description: AI ad workflows, product photography prompts, video ad styles and pricing for product photo ads.

tools.name: find_ad_workflow
tools.description: Match an advertising goal (platform, format, product type) to the Photo2Ads workflow that turns one product photo into that ad, with a guide page and a studio link.

goal.description: What the user wants to make, e.g. "TikTok UGC video for a skincare serum".

tools.name: search_product_photography_prompts
tools.description: Search 18 tested AI product photography prompts (studio, jewelry, skincare, packaging, lifestyle, fashion). Returns the reusable prompt, an example result image, and a link to use it in Photo2Ads.

query.description: Product or look, e.g. "perfume bottle on stone" or "jewelry".

tools.name: browse_video_ad_styles
tools.description: Browse 25 product video ad styles (UGC, TikTok hooks, commercial) with example videos and a link to start the same style from your own product photo.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Current free welcome credits, per-generation credit costs, subscription plans, and one-time credit packs.
